description: How you've set up Poe's stream overlay (atpota.to/overlay): which weather widgets show, where and how big, which side Poe sits on, and what it reacts to. One record per layout: "self" is the main one (atpota.to/overlay?streamer=<handle>), and any others are at their own record key, their id in the URL (&layout=<id>; lowercase letters, digits and dashes). The overlay reads it from your repo and follows changes live, so a stream's overlay changes as soon as you save.

name.description: What the streamer calls this layout, on the setup page only.

widgets.description: The widgets on screen, each kind at most once.

chat.description: Poe says hello to chatters and answers chat commands.

alerts.description: Poe says weather alerts (storms, apps blowing in).

visitors.description: Now and then a butterfly, bird, snail, worm or moth visits Poe.

ignore.description: Accounts Poe never greets, thanks or answers (bots).

volume.description: How loud Poe's noises are; 0 is silent.

nap.description: Minutes of quiet before Poe naps; 0 never.

side.description: Which bottom corner Poe sits in; it faces into the screen.

kind.description: The atmosphere's weather (card to pulse), Anisota's moon, mark and loader, the time as a TID, the streamer's flushes (im.flushing.right.now), status and vitals (is.dame.now, is.dame.state) and teal.fm music, or their stream.place chat.

slot.description: Where on screen. Widgets in the same slot stack.

style.description: How the widget looks, for the kinds with more than one way: tid (ticking, decoded, mini), flushes (count, stats, latest), status (both, status, vitals), music (now, history, stats, mini), chat (corner, side, pop). Absent or unknown is the kind's first.
